One of Canada’s Most Trusted Investment Brands.

At Picton Mahoney Asset Management (PICTON Investments),
being alternative isn’t just what we do—it’s who we are.

Founded by industry pioneer David Picton, we’ve spent 20 years challenging conventional wisdom and redefining the investing landscape. As one of Canada’s most trusted investment brands, we are proudly independent—privately run, 100% employee-owned, and deeply committed to delivering results for our clients.

Thinking Alternatively is in Our DNA

With a team of 233 bold thinkers—one-third dedicated solely to investment management—we are specialists, not generalists. Managing over $19.9 billion (September 30, 2026) for institutional and retail clients, we navigate markets with conviction, resilience, and a forward-thinking approach.

We’re more than investors — we’re innovators. We challenge traditional investment mindsets, constantly pushing the boundaries to achieve our mission: To bring greater certainty to investors.

Our success is built on four guiding principles:

Treat investors’ money like our own.
Redefine the way investors invest.
Be human—always approachable.
Succeed together, one investment at a time.

These aren’t just words—they define how we think, how we invest, and how we work.

Now, we’re entering our next chapter. We’re transforming our brand and reshaping the way the world invests. If you think alternatively, embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, and thrive in a dynamic, bureaucracy-free environment, join us and be part of what’s next.

Thriving in Our Entrepreneurial Culture

At PICTON Investments
, you’ll thrive in our creative and dynamic workplace, where collaboration and support are at the core of everything we do. At our firm, you’ll have the opportunity to take on significant responsibilities, work in a flexible environment, and tackle challenging projects from the outset. Our culture is designed for ambitious professionals who want to make an immediate impact while continuing to push boundaries and achieve our greater mission. You’ll be empowered with a high level of responsibility, trust, and flexibility, providing an exciting and creative space for you to help reshape how the world views alternative investments. With competitive total rewards, performance-based bonuses, and a clear path for career growth, you’ll have everything you need to develop both now and over the longer term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Vice President, Data Engineering to define and lead PICTON's data strategy across investment data, analytics, and AI, and to show what an AI-native data organization looks like in practice.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role
. You will be accountable for data across all PICTON's businesses. You'll own the architecture, governance, and engineering capabilities that turn complex financial data into reliable, accessible and actionable products for people and for AI agents. We want someone who embraces AI in their processes and who can bring that way of working across an entire team.

You will work closely with Engineering, Investment, Product, and AI teams
to build a modern data foundation that enables faster innovation and better decision-making.

What You'll Own

Data Strategy & AI-Ready Architecture

Serve as the single accountable owner for data across PICTON's businesses, setting direction, resolving competing priorities, and ensuring every business can rely on consistent, trusted data.
Define and execute PICTON's enterprise data strategy, architecture, and roadmap across Databricks, Snowflake, APIs, applications, analytics, and AI.
Own the technical build that enables PICTON's AI roadmap, working with AI and business leaders to sequence data capabilities so planned AI initiatives have the data, access, and governance they need to ship.
Design the platform so AI is a first-class consumer of data (e.g., well-governed semantic layers, rich metadata, and secure interfaces such as APIs and MCP servers that agents and LLM applications can reliably use).
Make pragmatic architecture decisions that balance performance, security, cost, and business needs, including the cost and governance of AI workloads.
Build a modern data platform supporting portfolio construction, performance, risk, analytics, and AI use cases.

AI-Accelerated Data Engineering & Governance

Lead the design of reliable, scalable pipelines for market, security, portfolio, and historical data, using AI coding assistants and agentic tools to shorten build and iteration cycles.
Apply AI to the data lifecycle itself, including automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, lineage and documentation generation, metadata enrichment, and reconciliation.
Establish practical standards for data quality, lineage, governance, security, and ownership, including guardrails for how AI tools and agents access sensitive financial data.
Evolve financial data models and semantic layers so data is consistent and reusable across products, teams, and AI systems.

Leadership, Mentorship & Culture

Build and lead a high-performing Data Engineering and Data Platform team
.
Partner with Engineering, Investment, Product, and AI leaders to translate business needs into effective data solutions.
Identify opportunities to leverage modern data and AI technologies to create competitive advantage.
Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, architecture, or technology leadership, including significant team leadership experience.
Experience owning data across multiple business lines or functions, including balancing their competing needs and driving shared standards.
Experience building agentic AI solutions: designing agents and workflows that use tools, retrieve from enterprise data, and operate within clear security and governance boundaries, along with practical approaches to evaluating their accuracy and reliability.
Strong experience with modern cloud data platforms, particularly Databricks, Snowflake, SQL, APIs, and distributed data pipelines.
Deep understanding of financial and investment data, including securities, portfolios, market data, performance, risk, and time-series data.
Experience building data platforms that support analytics, applications, and AI/LLM workloads, including retrieval, semantic layers, and structured data access for models.
Strong understanding of data governance, quality, lineage, security, and ownership, and how these extend to AI systems.
Ability to move between strategic thinking and technical detail, making pragmatic architecture decisions.
Strong business acumen and exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Hands-on, current use of AI in your own workflow. You regularly use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar to build, debug, document, and analyze, and you can give concrete examples of where it changed your speed or output.
Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, or AI cost management in production and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI to enterprise systems.
A track record of mentoring engineers and shaping team culture. You can point to people you've developed and to teams that took on more ownership and improved how they work under your leadership.

Our Commitment to Employees

At PICTON Investments
, we take pride in enhancing our employees' experiences through a comprehensive suite of exceptional perks and programs. Our benefits include corporate fitness reimbursement and discounts, VersaFi memberships (formerly Women in Capital Markets), Picton investment counseling and portfolio management services, volunteer and charitable donation matching, maternity and parental leave top-up, recognition awards, semi-annual performance bonuses, a generous annual vacation entitlement (minimum of 15 days per year), training and development reimbursement, extensive health and dental benefits, a healthcare spending account, and more.

These offerings are designed to support your career growth, well-being, and overall success. Join us and thrive in an environment that values and invests in you!

jobs.title: Principal & Head of Public Markets & Quant Technology
jobs.description:
We are pleased to be supporting Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group (“CC&L Financial Group”) in the search for a Head of Public Markets & Quant Technology
(the “Principal”). This is a newly created leadership role that will be instrumental in defining and delivering the technology strategy that supports the full public markets and quantitative investment lifecycle. Working in close partnership with investment professionals, quantitative researchers, traders, operations, risk, compliance, and finance teams, the successful candidate will modernize platforms, drive automation, improve data quality, strengthen operational resilience, and enable scalable, technology-led investment capabilities.

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity for an experienced technology executive who combines strategic vision, strong engineering expertise, and a deep understanding of investment workflows. The successful candidate will serve as the primary technology partner to Public Markets and Quant stakeholders, bringing together teams, capabilities, and priorities into a cohesive business-aligned function. The role offers significant front-office engagement, broad visibility across the organization, and the opportunity to lead a critical technology domain, influence the operating model, and serve as a strategic partner in delivering the next generation of investment technology.

Vancouver, BC or Toronto, ON (Hybrid)

About Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group

Connor, Clark & Lunn Financial Group is Canada’s largest and fastest growing privately owned asset management firm, providing a broad range of traditional and alternative investment products and services through a network of 15 affiliates and subsidiaries. With already more than $230 billion in assets under management, the organization combines the entrepreneurial strengths of its investment affiliates with the scale, operational expertise, and shared resources of a diversified enterprise.

As CC&L Financial Group continues to evolve its investment technology capabilities and operating model, the firm is seeking a senior leader to define and execute the technology strategy supporting its Public Markets and Quant businesses. This role will help shape the future of investment technology across portfolio management, research, trading, investment operations, and data capabilities, while driving modernization, automation, resilience, and measurable business outcomes.

The Opportunity

Reporting into the Co-Heads of Technology, the Principal will lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of technology capabilities across the public markets and quantitative investment ecosystem. This includes portfolio management, investment research, analytics, trading, investment operations, post-trade workflows, data quality, reporting, and platform resilience.

The Principal will serve as the primary technology partner to investment professionals and business stakeholders, translating business priorities into a clear technology roadmap while balancing long-term modernization objectives with practical execution. They will collaborate closely with enterprise technology teams across data, AI and automation, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, service management, quality assurance, release management, and site reliability to bring enterprise-grade capabilities and standards into the public markets and quantitative investing domain.

This is not a traditional application ownership or support role. It is a business-facing technology leadership position with accountability for technology outcomes across the full investment lifecycle and an opportunity to lead meaningful transformation across a critical investment technology function.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap for Public Markets and Quant Technology, aligning investments with business priorities and organizational objectives.
Partner with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, traders, operations, risk, compliance, and finance teams to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Lead the modernization of investment platforms, processes, and architecture across front-, middle-, and back-office functions.
Oversee technology capabilities supporting portfolio management, investment research, analytics, decision-support tools, trading, order management, execution, trade capture, and post-trade workflows.
Drive automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve straight-through processing, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency across the investment lifecycle.
Lead the evolution of quantitative and systematic investment platforms, including research-to-production workflows and technology capabilities supporting quantitative investing.
Establish and champion modern engineering practices, including cloud adoption, APIs, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, automated testing, data validation, production telemetry, and site reliability principles.
Improve platform resilience, operational risk management, service quality, production support practices, and incident reduction through proactive monitoring and continuous improvement.
Oversee investment data foundations, including market data, reference data, security master capabilities, data quality, lineage, governance, and controls.
Partner with enterprise technology teams across data, AI and automation, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud services, service management, quality assurance, and release management to leverage shared capabilities and standards.
Lead and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team of engineers, analysts, product owners, technology specialists, support professionals, and domain experts, helping shape team structure, operating practices, and capabilities as the organization continues to evolve its business-aligned technology model.
Simplify complexity across technology and operating environments while improving data quality, governance, scalability, and organizational effectiveness.

Skills and Qualifications

Extensive experience leading technology organizations within investment management, asset management, hedge funds, capital markets, trading technology, or broader financial services environments.
Strong understanding of front-to-back investment workflows, including portfolio management, trading, positions, P&L, risk, settlement, reconciliation, reporting, data flows, and operational processes supporting investment management.
Demonstrated track record leading technology transformation and modernization initiatives within complex, regulated, or high-scale environments, including platform modernization, architecture simplification, automation, data strategy, resiliency improvements, and operating model evolution.
Strong engineering leadership and technical credibility, with the ability to influence architecture decisions, challenge technical approaches, engage senior engineering teams, and drive operational excellence.
Exposure to platforms such as OMS, EMS, PMS, IBOR, ABOR, risk, performance, reconciliation, fund accounting, market data, or investment data solutions is considered valuable.
Experience with quantitative or systematic investing technology and research-to-production investment platforms is considered an asset.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to build credibility and partner effectively across investment, operations, risk, compliance, finance, technology, and executive leadership teams.
Demonstrated success building and leading high-performing multidisciplinary teams across engineering, product, operations, support, and vendor management functions.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical execution, bringing sound judgment, strong leadership presence, and a focus on measurable business outcomes.
